# IMPERIA COLD WAR — Eastern Bloc Social Contract (on actions)
# Generated by Claude outputs/COLDWAR_EB_generator/build.py - do not edit by hand.
on_actions = {
	# members get the Social Contract from the first day, not only after the first month
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_game_rule = { rule = COLDWAR_EB_rule option = OFF } } }
				every_country = {
					limit = {
						COLDWAR_EB_is_member = yes
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EB_member }
					}
					COLDWAR_EB_join = yes
				}
				if = { limit = { country_exists = SOV } SOV = { COLDWAR_EB_ui_moscow = yes } }
			}
		}
	}
	on_monthly = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized
					NOT = { has_game_rule = { rule = COLDWAR_EB_rule option = OFF } }
				}
				if = {
					# COLDWAR | hand patch 08.11.2026 (performance): day stamp gate instead of the timed global flag; the flag is still set for other readers.
					limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_EB_monthly_done_next_day > global.num_days } } }
					set_global_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_EB_monthly_done days = 27 value = 1 }
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_EB_monthly_done_next_day = global.num_days }
					add_to_variable = { global.COLDWAR_EB_monthly_done_next_day = 27 }
					COLDWAR_EB_global_monthly = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EB_member
							COLDWAR_EB_is_member = yes
							has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EB_democratised
							has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EB_was_lid
							is_in_array = { global.COLDWAR_EB_restorable = THIS }
						}
					}
					COLDWAR_EB_country_monthly = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_weekly = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_EB_contract_total > 0 } }
				COLDWAR_EB_contracts_weekly = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
